title: Global profiling of lysine benzoylation in S. cerevisiae
projectDescription: Identification of 207 Kbz sites on 149 non-histone proteins by LC-MS/MS
sampleProcessingProtocol: The whole cell proteins were reductive alkylated or chemical propionylated, respectively. Then, the samples were digested with trypsin (sample: trypsin=1:50) at pH 8-9. The peptides were desalinated and enriched by the anti-Kbz antibody conjugated beads or pan-anti-Kbz antibody, eluted by 0.15% TFA and analyzed by the LC-MS/MS.
dataProcessingProtocol: The benzoylation identification search was performed with the PEAKS Studio 8.5 against Uniprot Yeast protein database (6721 entries, http://www.uniprot.org).
